title: Ragtime and Blind Boone: what he knew of St. Louis-area piano
summary: DeMichael asks about ragtime repertoire and Blind Boone's piano rolls; Randolph knew Boone only from his mother's talk.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: What kind of music did you play at the recitals? Ragtime was very strong in the St. Louis area,
which of course is not too far from Arkansas.
Well, no. She was strict, you would have to play just that --
Had you ever heard of Blind Boone?
I didn't get a chance to hear him but I heard my mother talking about him. They say he was a wonderful pianist.
I heard some rolls that he cut around 1908, '10, something in there.
Just a marvelous player, unbelievable. Like Tatum.
Just marvelous. He had a piece, the 2 gavotte, that he went through the whole cycle of fifths in like four bars.
Yes. It was unbelievable. I didn't know people played like that, and I thought maybe you had heard
